sources.cite: Beagle et al., Heavy-Duty Gas Turbine Operating and Maintenance Considerations, GE GER-3620P (2021): printed p. 3 split casings, upper halves lifted one at a time, stator rows slid out; p. 16 the casings; figs. 31, 32, 34 the combustion, hot gas path and major inspections

Brandt and Wesorick, GE Gas Turbine Design Philosophy, GE GER-3434D (1994): p. 2 inlet guide vanes; pp. 5-6 a compressor of disks on tie bolts; pp. 8-10 cans, six fuel nozzles on each end cover, liner, transition piece; pp. 13-15 three turbine stages

GE Power Systems, Gas Turbine and Combined Cycle Products, GEA-12985B (2002): p. 6 F class machines with an 18-stage compressor, a three-stage turbine, a cold-end drive and an axial exhaust; p. 5 the H class's 12 and 14 cans
Baker Hughes, Frame 9/1E gas turbine overview (2025): p. 5 horizontally split casings; p. 6 a 17-stage compressor, three turbine stages with cooled first and second stages, 14 combustion chambers

US patent 2,912,156 (GE, 1959), Inlet casing for axial flow compressor: figs. 1, 2 and 4, the inlet plenum round the casing, the flared bellmouth, the bearing housing inside the inlet casing split at a horizontal flange
US patent 8,388,314 (GE, 2013), Turbine inlet casing with integral bearing housing: figs. 2-5, the inner and outer bellmouths and the split bearing housing

US patent 11,572,806 (GE, 2023): the thrust bearing beside the compressor's inlet bellmouth with a journal bearing, the generator coupled to the shaft (fig. 2); to reach them the upper bearing housing comes off, then the thrust bearing, then the upper journal bearing (figs. 6-7)
US patent 11,761,347 (GE, 2023), Exhaust frame differential cooling system: figs. 1A, 2 and 3, the exhaust frame's inner and outer barrels joined by struts, the bearing tunnel in the inner barrel
US patent 7,493,769 (GE, 2009): fig. 1, the rear bearing inside the exhaust frame, its struts ending in the exhaust diffuser
US patent 10,184,357 (GE, 2019), background and figs. 2-3: each upper casing section (inlet, compressor, combustor, turbine, exhaust) taken off, then a crane lifts the rotor out of the lower casing

US patent 8,893,501 (GE, 2014), Combustor crossfire tube: figs. 2-3, the liner inside the flow sleeve inside the combustion casing, the air running between them, crossfire tubes between neighbouring cans

US Navy, Gas Turbine Systems Technician, NAVEDTRA 14114, vol. 2, ch. 1, p. 1-18 and fig. 1-19 (as adapted by CED Engineering, M04-041, pdf p. 21): can-annular combustors, separate cans in an annular case, one or more fuel nozzles in each
US patent 6,382,903 (GE, 2002): fig. 3, turbine wheels and spacers held together by axial bolts round the rotor, with rabbeted joints

base.name: Foundation and base frame
base.does: The concrete block and the steel supports the machine stands on: the compressor's and the turbine's legs carry the lower casings.

intake.name: Air inlet plenum and duct
intake.does: The box round the compressor's inlet, fed from the filter house above: it turns the filtered air into the bellmouth.

bell_upper.name: Inlet bellmouth, upper half
bell_upper.does: The upper half of the flared ring that leads the air smoothly into the compressor's first row; split at the joint round the shaft, it lifts off for a major inspection. (simplified)

bell_lower.name: Inlet bellmouth, lower half
bell_lower.does: The lower half of the flared ring, under the shaft: the rotor lifts off over it. (simplified)

brg1_housing.name: Front bearing housing
brg1_housing.does: The pedestal at the cold end that carries the front journal bearing and the thrust bearing; the shaft leaves it to the generator.

brg1_cover.name: Front bearing housing cover
brg1_cover.does: The upper part of the housing: it comes off to reach the bearings. (simplified)

brg1_upper.name: Front journal bearing, upper half
brg1_upper.does: Closes the journal bearing over the shaft.

brg1_lower.name: Front journal bearing, lower half
brg1_lower.does: Carries the rotor's front end on an oil film.

thrust.name: Thrust bearing, upper half
thrust.does: Pads on both faces of the rotor's thrust collar hold the rotor in its place along the axis against the compressor's and the turbine's pull; the upper half comes off before the rotor is lifted. (simplified)

thrust_lower.name: Thrust bearing, lower half
thrust_lower.does: The lower halves of the pad rings either side of the thrust collar: the rotor lifts off over them. (simplified)

comp_lower.name: Compressor casing, lower half
comp_lower.does: Holds the lower halves of the stator rows; its flanges meet the upper half at the horizontal joint.

comp_upper.name: Compressor casing, upper half
comp_upper.does: Bolted to the lower half at the horizontal joint; lifted off to reach the compressor's blading.

igv_upper.name: Inlet guide vanes, upper half
igv_upper.does: Vanes ahead of the first stage that turn to let more or less air in: closed at start-up and low load. (simplified)

igv_lower.name: Inlet guide vanes, lower half
igv_lower.does: The lower half of the variable inlet guide vanes.

cvanes_upper.name: Compressor stator rows, upper half
cvanes_upper.does: The fixed vanes between the moving rows: they turn the air and slow it, so its pressure rises stage by stage. They slide out of the casing's grooves.

cvanes_lower.name: Compressor stator rows, lower half
cvanes_lower.does: The lower halves of the stator rows.

bleed_pipes.name: Compressor bleed pipes
bleed_pipes.does: Take air off a middle stage at start-up and shutdown so the compressor doesn't stall.

cdc_lower.name: Compressor discharge casing, lower half
cdc_lower.does: The casing after the compressor that holds the air at full pressure round the combustion system; the cans are mounted on it.

cdc_upper.name: Compressor discharge casing, upper half
cdc_upper.does: Bolted to the lower half at the joint; lifted off in a major inspection.

fuel_ring.name: Fuel gas manifold
fuel_ring.does: The ring main round the cans and its pigtails to each end cover, fed from the fuel gas supply.

tshell_lower.name: Turbine shell, lower half
tshell_lower.does: Holds the lower halves of the nozzle rows and the shrouds round the buckets; insulated outside.

tshell_upper.name: Turbine shell, upper half
tshell_upper.does: Lifted off in a hot gas path inspection to reach the nozzles and buckets.

brg2_upper.name: Rear journal bearing, upper half
brg2_upper.does: Closes the rear bearing over the shaft (drawn just ahead of the exhaust frame: a real one sits in its inner barrel).

brg2_lower.name: Rear journal bearing, lower half
brg2_lower.does: Carries the rotor's hot end on an oil film.

exhaust.name: Exhaust frame and diffuser
exhaust.does: Behind the last stage: the frame carries the rear bearing on struts, and the diffuser widens to slow the gas on its way to the heat recovery boiler.

rotor.name: Rotor
rotor.does: The compressor's disks, the distance piece and the turbine's wheels, held together by tie bolts: one shaft that turns the compressor and the generator.
rotor.sealed_why: In this view the rotor comes out and goes back as one assembly with its blades and buckets; changing a blade or a bucket is not drawn.

cblades.name: Compressor rotor blades
cblades.does: The moving rows on the compressor's disks: they push the air on, shorter stage by stage as it is squeezed.

tnoz1_u.name: Stage 1 nozzles, upper half
tnoz1_u.does: The first stage's stationary vanes: they speed the hot gas up and turn it onto the buckets. Air-cooled.

tnoz1_l.name: Stage 1 nozzles, lower half
tnoz1_l.does: The lower half of the first stage's nozzles.

tbucket1.name: Stage 1 buckets
tbucket1.does: The first stage's blades on the turbine wheel: the gas drives them round. Air-cooled from inside.

tnoz2_u.name: Stage 2 nozzles, upper half
tnoz2_u.does: The second stage's stationary vanes: they speed the hot gas up and turn it onto the buckets. Air-cooled.

tnoz2_l.name: Stage 2 nozzles, lower half
tnoz2_l.does: The lower half of the second stage's nozzles.

tbucket2.name: Stage 2 buckets
tbucket2.does: The second stage's blades on the turbine wheel: the gas drives them round. Air-cooled from inside.

tnoz3_u.name: Stage 3 nozzles, upper half
tnoz3_u.does: The third stage's stationary vanes: they speed the hot gas up and turn it onto the buckets.

tnoz3_l.name: Stage 3 nozzles, lower half
tnoz3_l.does: The lower half of the third stage's nozzles.

tbucket3.name: Stage 3 buckets
tbucket3.does: The third stage's blades on the turbine wheel: the gas drives them round.

can_01.name: Combustion can 1
can_01.does: The can's casing and flow sleeve: compressor air flows back between them to the head end.

cover_01.name: End cover 1 with its fuel nozzles
cover_01.does: Closes the can's head end and carries its fuel nozzles (six drawn, as on GE's Dry Low NOx cans).

liner_01.name: Combustion liner 1
liner_01.does: The flame burns inside it; air through its holes mixes in and cools it.

tp_01.name: Transition piece 1
tp_01.does: Carries the hot gas from the liner to the first stage's nozzles, from round to a sector of the annulus.

text: Connect the bleed pipes to the compressor casing.
needs: comp_upper
The bleed pipes connect to the upper casing: lower it first.
Take the bleed pipes off before the upper compressor casing is lifted.

text: Close the bellmouth with its upper half, bolted to the upper casing's inlet flange and to the lower half at the joint.
needs: comp_upper
The upper half bolts to the upper casing: close the casing first.
Take the bellmouth's upper half off before the upper compressor casing is lifted.
bell_lower
It closes on the lower half: set that first.
Take the upper half off before the lower half.

text: Close the inlet plenum round the bellmouth and connect it to the duct from the filter house.
needs: bell_upper
The plenum closes round the bellmouth: close it first.
Open the plenum before the bellmouth's upper half is taken off.

run_exploded.why: A gas turbine runs only closed: the casings hold the air and the hot gas, the bearings the rotor. Put it back together first.

open_running.why: A turning machine is never opened. Stop it and let the rotor come to standstill on its turning gear first.
